text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and analyse text, so they can find the main ideas or answer questions. NLP is also used for translation, which means it can change text from one language into another. Another common use is sentiment analysis, where a computer decides if a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people and give helpful answers. Thanks to NLP, we can communicate with technology in a more natural and useful way.
